name: Angus Campbell
bio:
Angus Campbell, a young but determined team principal, hails from Melbourne, Australia, where his passion for motorsport ignited at a young age watching V8 Supercars at Bathurst. He quickly moved into karting and then Formula Ford, before realizing his true strengths lay in the strategic and managerial aspects of racing.

He transitioned to engineering roles, quickly climbing the ranks with his keen understanding of both technical and human factors. Angus believes in fostering a data-driven environment while maintaining a strong sense of team unity. He's known for his meticulous planning and relentless pursuit of performance gains, often pushing his team to the limit. His approach is hands-on, frequently found on the pit wall and engaging directly with engineers and drivers alike, seeking to optimize every aspect of the team's performance.

His distinctive ability to bridge the gap between the technical and human elements of motorsport, coupled with his unwavering commitment to excellence, positions him as a rising star within the paddock. He is known for his detailed approach and for expecting the best from everyone around him.

physical.description: A lean and focused individual, he has a permanent air of intensity about him.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on a strict timetable for all meetings and hates being kept waiting.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
